lines.text: David asks the LORD where to go, is told Hebron, and goes there with his two wives.
David's men settle near Hebron with their households, and the men of Judah anoint David king over Judah.
David learns that the men of Ziklag buried Saul, so he sends messengers to bless them.
Abner, Saul's army commander, moves Ish-bosheth to Bethlehem and makes him king over all Israel.
Judah follows David, who is king in Hebron over the house of Judah for seven years and six months.
